brand.name: Slow Mornings

slides.headline: green flags in a morning routine
slides.prompt: Candid iPhone-style photo, 1080x1350 portrait. Soft natural window light falling across a rumpled linen bed and a mug of coffee on a wooden nightstand, warm muted film grade, slightly imperfect framing. No people. ABSOLUTELY NO text, words, letters or numbers. Keep the bottom third calm and uncluttered for an overlay. Real room, ordinary objects, no studio lighting, no magazine polish. No watermark, no logos, no AI gloss.
